### `ai_model_versions`

The model registry. At most one row is active (partial unique index). Versions that ai-service reports and nobody registered are added inactive, with a note.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Keys |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `model_id` | varchar(128) | no |  | PK |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `clock_timestamp()` |  |
| `training_from` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| `training_to` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| `data_hash` | varchar(128) | yes |  |  |

| `notes` | text | yes |  |  |

- PK `pk` (model_id)

**Indexes**

- `uq_ai_model_versions_one_active` UNIQUE (ai_model_versions.is_active) WHERE `is_active`

### `ai_setup_sizes`

A setup sized for one user (B10, ``app/ai/sizing.py``): by ai-service ``/v1/size`` or, when it is unavailable, by the backend's B4 lot sizing (``source``). ``inputs`` is what the size depends on (account, risk, spec and setup hashes, guard): the same inputs reuse it.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Keys |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `setup_id` | varchar(128) | no |  | PK, FK |
| `user_id` | uuid | no |  | PK, FK |
| `lots` | double precision | no |  |  |
| `risk_usd` | double precision | no |  |  |
| `margin_required` | double precision | yes |  |  |
| `feasible` | boolean | no |  |  |
| `warnings` | jsonb | no | `'[]'::jsonb` |  |
| `inputs` | jsonb | no |  |  |
| `source` | varchar(16) | no | `local` |  |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `clock_timestamp()` |  |
| `computed_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `clock_timestamp()` |  |

**Constraints**

- PK `pk` (setup_id, user_id)
- FK (setup_id) → ai_setups (setup_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
- FK (user_id) → users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
- CHECK `ck_ai_setup_sizes_source`: `source IN ('remote', 'local')`

### `ai_setup_takes`

A user says they took a setup (B10). ``lots`` / ``risk_amount`` default to their stored size; when the setup ends, ``apply_evaluation`` fills ``closed_at``, ``realized_r``, ``pnl = realized_r * risk_amount`` and ``close_reason`` (EXPIRED / INVALIDATED: 0).

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Keys |

| `entry_price` | double precision | yes |  |  |
| `closed_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| `realized_r` | double precision | yes |  |  |
| `pnl` | double precision | yes |  |  |
| `close_reason` | varchar(64) | yes |  |  |

**Constraints**

- PK `pk` (setup_id, user_id)
- FK (setup_id) → ai_setups (setup_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

### `ai_setup_outbox`

A setup state change to notify (B11): written by ``apply_evaluation`` in its own transaction, so no alert is lost on a crash; sent by the ``ai_alerts.dispatch`` task. Unique ``(setup_id, to_state)``: a replayed evaluation never enqueues twice. DEVELOPING is never written.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Keys |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | bigint | no | `Identity()` | PK |
| `setup_id` | varchar(128) | no |  | FK |
| `from_state` | varchar(16) | yes |  |  |
| `to_state` | varchar(16) | no |  |  |
| `at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| `reason` | varchar(255) | yes |  |  |
| `realized_r` | double precision | yes |  |  |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `clock_timestamp()` |  |
| `status` | varchar(16) | no | `pending` |  |
| `attempts` | integer | no | `0` |  |
| `next_attempt_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `clock_timestamp()` |  |
| `last_error` | varchar(500) | yes |  |  |
| `processed_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |

**Constraints**

- PK `pk` (id)
- FK (setup_id) → ai_setups (setup_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
- CHECK `ck_ai_setup_outbox_status`: `status IN ('pending', 'done', 'skipped', 'failed')`
- CHECK `ck_ai_setup_outbox_to`: `to_state IN ('DEVELOPING', 'ARMED', 'ACTIVE', 'CLOSED', 'EXPIRED', 'INVALIDATED')`
- UNIQUE `uq_ai_setup_outbox_setup_state` (setup_id, to_state)

**Indexes**

- `ix_ai_setup_outbox_due` (ai_setup_outbox.next_attempt_at) WHERE `status = 'pending'`

One ``ai.evaluate`` run (B9, ``app/ai/evaluate.py``) of an instrument, profile and bar: what happened (``status``: ok, abstained, skipped, unavailable, contract_error, error), why (``reason``), the request size and bar coverage, and a summary of the answer (or of the local abstention when ai-service was not called). Read by ``/admin/system/status``.

**Indexes**

- `ix_ai_evaluation_runs_finished` (ai_evaluation_runs.finished_at)

| `body` | text | no |  |  |

### `notification_deliveries`

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Keys |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | PK |
| `notification_id` | uuid | no |  | FK |

| `status` | enum delivery_status (pending, sent, failed, skipped) | no | `pending` |  |
| `attempts` | integer | no | `0` |  |
| `last_error` | varchar(300) | yes |  |  |
| `provider_message_id` | varchar(255) | yes |  |  |
| `hold` | varchar(16) | yes |  |  |
| `release_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `clock_timestamp()` |  |
| `sent_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| `next_attempt_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |

**Constraints**

- PK `pk` (id)
- FK (notification_id) → notifications (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
- UNIQUE `uq_notification_deliveries_target` (notification_id, channel, target)

**Indexes**

- `ix_notification_deliveries_created` (notification_deliveries.created_at)
- `ix_notification_deliveries_due` (notification_deliveries.release_at) WHERE `status = 'pending' AND hold IS NOT NULL`
- `ix_notification_deliveries_unsent` (coalesce(next_attempt_at, created_at)) WHERE `status = 'pending' AND hold IS NULL`

**Indexes**

- `ix_content_reports_status_created` (content_reports.status, content_reports.created_at)
- `ix_content_reports_target` (content_reports.target_type, content_reports.target_id)

## Subscriptions and chat

### `expert_profiles`

An expert's public profile, shown in the experts directory when listed.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Keys |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | uuid | no |  | PK, FK |
| `headline` | varchar(120) | no |  |  |
| `bio` | text | no |  |  |
| `markets` | varchar(32)[] | no | `'{}'` |  |
| `languages` | varchar(8)[] | no | `'{}'` |  |
| `chat_enabled` | boolean | no | `true` |  |
| `response_time_hint` | varchar(60) | yes |  |  |
| `is_listed` | boolean | no | `true` |  |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `clock_timestamp()` |  |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `clock_timestamp()` |  |

**Constraints**

- PK `pk` (user_id)
- FK (user_id) → users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE

**Indexes**

- `ix_expert_profiles_listed` (expert_profiles.is_listed)

### `subscription_plans`

An expert's offer. Price changes only apply to new subscriptions: a subscription keeps the price it was bought at (copied onto it) until it ends.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Keys |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | PK |
| `expert_id` | uuid | no |  | FK |
| `name` | varchar(60) | no |  |  |
| `description` | varchar(1000) | no |  |  |
| `price` | numeric(12, 2) | no |  |  |
| `currency` | varchar(3) | no | `USD` |  |
| `interval` | enum plan_interval (month, year) | no |  |  |
| `trial_days` | integer | no | `0` |  |
| `perks` | jsonb | no |  |  |
| `is_active` | boolean | no | `true` |  |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `clock_timestamp()` |  |

**Constraints**

- PK `pk` (id)
- FK (expert_id) → users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
- CHECK `ck_subscription_plans_price`: `price >= 0`
- CHECK `ck_subscription_plans_trial`: `trial_days BETWEEN 0 AND 30`

**Indexes**

- `ix_subscription_plans_expert` (subscription_plans.expert_id, subscription_plans.is_active)

### `subscriptions`

``price``, ``currency``, ``interval`` and ``perks`` are copied from the plan when the subscription starts and when it renews. ``payment_method`` keeps only ``{brand, last4, behavior}`` (never a card number).

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Keys |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | PK |
| `user_id` | uuid | no |  | FK |
| `expert_id` | uuid | no |  | FK |
| `plan_id` | uuid | no |  | FK |
| `status` | enum subscription_status (trialing, active, past_due, canceled, expired) | no |  |  |
| `price` | numeric(12, 2) | no |  |  |
| `currency` | varchar(3) | no |  |  |
| `interval` | enum plan_interval (month, year) | no |  |  |
| `perks` | jsonb | no |  |  |
| `payment_method` | jsonb | yes |  |  |
| `current_period_start` | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| `current_period_end` | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| `cancel_at_period_end` | boolean | no | `false` |  |
| `canceled_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| `past_due_since` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| `ended_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `clock_timestamp()` |  |

**Constraints**

- PK `pk` (id)
- FK (expert_id) → users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
- FK (plan_id) → subscription_plans (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
- FK (user_id) → users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
- CHECK `ck_subscriptions_not_self`: `user_id <> expert_id`

**Indexes**

- `ix_subscriptions_due` (subscriptions.current_period_end) WHERE `status IN ('trialing', 'active', 'past_due')`
- `ix_subscriptions_expert_status` (subscriptions.expert_id, subscriptions.status)
- `ix_subscriptions_user` (subscriptions.user_id, created_at DESC)
- `uq_subscriptions_live` UNIQUE (subscriptions.user_id, subscriptions.expert_id) WHERE `status IN ('trialing', 'active', 'past_due')`

### `invoices`

A charge for one subscription period (trial 0.00, initial, renewal); fee and expert share are set when paid.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Keys |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | PK |
| `number` | varchar(20) | no |  | UK |
| `subscription_id` | uuid | no |  | FK |
| `user_id` | uuid | no |  | FK |
| `expert_id` | uuid | no |  | FK |
| `kind` | varchar(16) | no |  |  |
| `amount` | numeric(12, 2) | no |  |  |
| `currency` | varchar(3) | no |  |  |
| `status` | enum invoice_status (open, paid, failed, refunded, void) | no |  |  |
| `period_start` | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| `period_end` | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| `platform_fee` | numeric(12, 2) | yes |  |  |
| `expert_amount` | numeric(12, 2) | yes |  |  |
| `provider` | varchar(16) | no |  |  |
| `provider_ref` | varchar(100) | yes |  |  |
| `failure_reason` | varchar(200) | yes |  |  |
| `paid_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| `refunded_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `clock_timestamp()` |  |

**Constraints**

- PK `pk` (id)

- FK (user_id) → users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
- UNIQUE `None` (number)
- UNIQUE (number)

**Indexes**

- `ix_invoices_expert_paid` (invoices.expert_id, invoices.paid_at)
- `ix_invoices_subscription` (invoices.subscription_id, created_at DESC)
- `ix_invoices_user` (invoices.user_id, created_at DESC)

### `checkout_sessions`

One payment attempt for a plan on the provider's hosted page (valid 30 minutes).

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Keys |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | PK |

### `payment_events`

Every provider event processed, once (``event_id`` unique).

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Keys |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | PK |
| `provider` | varchar(16) | no |  |  |
| `event_id` | varchar(100) | no |  | UK |
| `type` | varchar(40) | no |  |  |
| `payload` | jsonb | no |  |  |

### `conversations`

The chat between one expert and one subscriber (unique pair), with both read markers.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Keys |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | PK |
| `expert_id` | uuid | no |  | FK |
| `user_id` | uuid | no |  | FK |
| `status` | enum conversation_status (open, closed, blocked) | no | `open` |  |
| `blocked_by` | uuid | yes |  | FK |
| `last_message_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| `expert_last_read_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| `user_last_read_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `clock_timestamp()` |  |

**Constraints**

- PK `pk` (id)
- FK (blocked_by) → users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
- FK (expert_id) → users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
- FK (user_id) → users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
- UNIQUE `uq_conversations_pair` (expert_id, user_id)

**Indexes**

- `ix_conversations_expert_last` (conversations.expert_id, last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST)
- `ix_conversations_user_last` (conversations.user_id, last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST)

### `messages`

``client_id``: a uuid made by the client, unique per sender, so a retried send returns the first message instead of a duplicate. Deleting leaves a tombstone (``deleted_at``, empty body).

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Keys |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | PK |
| `conversation_id` | uuid | no |  | FK |
| `sender_id` | uuid | no |  | FK |
| `body` | text | no |  |  |
| `attachments` | jsonb | no | `'[]'::jsonb` |  |
| `client_id` | uuid | no |  |  |
| `edited_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| `deleted_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `clock_timestamp()` |  |

**Constraints**

- PK `pk` (id)
- FK (conversation_id) → conversations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
- FK (sender_id) → users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
- UNIQUE `uq_messages_sender_client` (sender_id, client_id)

**Indexes**

- `ix_messages_conversation_created` (messages.conversation_id, created_at DESC)
